notes.title: Update mouse sensitivity and screen mode settings!
notes.content: We noticed that some users had problems with mouse sensitivity, so we completely reworked the logic of camera movement. We also added in the settings the possibility to change full screen mode to windowed mode and vice versa, because some players asked for it.
